topicA: AI's Impact on Search and Content Strategy
topicB: Data Quality and Signal Loss in B2B Marketing

recap.intro: This week you explored two dynamic areas of B2B marketing: the evolving role of AI in search and content, and the crucial impact of data quality on your marketing efforts.
bullets: Agentic AI is shifting content strategists' roles from simply creating content to orchestrating the entire content process, with human oversight remaining crucial.
To succeed in AI-powered search, businesses must invest in creating high-quality content and building their website's authority as a trusted source.
Often, when AI doesn't perform as expected, the issue lies with the quality of the data it receives, not with the AI's intelligence itself.
Even with widespread AI adoption in B2B marketing, human judgment and quality assurance roles are becoming increasingly valuable.
recap.closing: This week you learned that while AI is transforming B2B marketing, human oversight, quality data, and critical judgment are more essential than ever.
